title: [Bug][SubscriptionBilling]: Performance: Billing document creation does not scale to large datasets (4M+ subscription lines)
summary: Billing document creation now scales to millions of subscription lines through code optimizations, database indexes, transaction checkpoints, and progress tracking, eliminating redundant lookups and event dispatch overhead.
key_points: New Progress Tracker codeunit provides reusable ETA dialog for long-running operations with Job Queue safety
Transaction commits added at intervals (per 10 contracts, per document) to prevent timeout on large datasets
Dictionary-based aggregation and SetLoadFields replace O(n) loops and uncached Gets for performance
Database indexes added or extended on BillingLine, SubscriptionLine, UsageDataBilling, and related tables
Removed redundant event subscribers by inlining logic into hot paths to reduce dispatch overhead
